definition: A revisable research representation of which RSI/agent structures repeatedly survive independent external experiments, which causal anti-laws repeatedly fail, where Ordivon already has stronger direct evidence, and which frontiers remain genuinely unresolved.
epistemicBoundary: Literature is evidence about Reality, not authority over owner-native Ordivon state. Recent single-team preprints provide hypothesis-strength evidence until replicated or independently converged at the structural motif level.

convergenceThesis.claim: Surviving systems from independent domains repeatedly rediscover a low-dimensional set of semantic distinctions. Failed implementations have high surface diversity, but their causal failure mechanisms also recur as a smaller set of anti-laws.
convergenceThesis.not: Correctness does not imply one shared architecture, and error is not causally structureless chaos.

stableStructures.name: Held-out / OOD / variant generalization beyond optimized signal
Explicit compact persistent state with causal/provenance/constraint content
stableStructures.ordivon: Canonical History / Working Set / Claim / Unknown

stableStructures.name: Adaptive/control overhead must repay itself versus a strong simpler baseline
Metaproductivity: improvement must include future ability to improve
World-model prediction must be calibrated against realized transitions
Multi-axis domain truth instead of single scalar proxy

stableAntiLaws.name: Visible metric or public score equals real improvement
Local benchmark/seed/literature gain equals general frontier progress
Current performance equals future self-improvement value
Raw growing context or arbitrary lossy compaction is sufficient state management
One fixed global search/harness policy is sufficient
More search/orchestration/complexity is automatically more intelligent
One domain metric is enough to establish semantic success

ordivonStrongerOrDistinctEvidence: Serial per-observation marginal-value narration does not create stopping competence (RF1 + HP2 independent internal falsifiers).
A correct meta-rule in context does not create the corresponding control competence (TM1 + HP2 + HP3).
Exact owner currentness/binding evidence is not sufficient semantic-applicability competence after drift (HP4).
Exact replay/reconciliation of a previously admitted identity is distinct from a fresh new consequence (HP4).
Task progress is not frozen research-pressure progress; outcome evidence must bind the exact pressure/discriminator (FS0).
Open-world research-frontier selection across heterogeneous owner goals, costs and authority remains directly under-tested externally.

openFrontiers.name: Open-world research problem selection
openFrontiers.reason: Scientific taste work optimizes impact preference, while evidence also shows current agents narrow exploration; no mature multi-owner multi-objective selector exists.

openFrontiers.name: Ignition / third-order generalization
openFrontiers.reason: AIDE² explicitly reports Level-1-like evidence but not ignition; HGM/MetaSkill motivate metaproductivity without proving sustained accelerating improvement.

openFrontiers.name: Evaluator evolution without hidden truth collapse
openFrontiers.reason: Anchors/private holdouts help but remain exogenous trust roots; owner reality may be only partially observable.

openFrontiers.name: Stopping on naturally expensive evidence universes
openFrontiers.reason: RF1/HP2 reject serial self-questioning; CHILL supports advantage-gated interventions but does not settle evidence stopping.

openFrontiers.name: Semantic applicability after safe owner-binding conflict
openFrontiers.reason: External work supports verification/binding; Ordivon HP4 shows currentness does not decide whether old semantic intent still applies.

openFrontiers.name: Real external effect ambiguity / replay / effect-principal separation
openFrontiers.reason: State-based benchmarks support consequence verification, but live ambiguous delivery and owner-bound replay remain weakly covered.

rsiPathUpdate: World Model M predicts reality and is corrected by observed transitions.
Research Frontier Model T predicts which pressure/operator/budget/evaluator is likely to create trusted frontier-changing evidence.
ResearchBet freezes the prediction before outcome evidence.
Owner-bound Outcome evaluates both task/frontier value and the correctness of the research prediction.
Update M and T separately; selection correctness, explanation correctness and consequence correctness are distinct.
Track metaproductivity: did the improvement change the future production function of improvement?
Require held-out improved-improver evidence before claiming ignition.
Use stable anti-laws as priors for cheap falsification, never as Agent-facing authority without prospective evidence.
promotionPolicy: LW0 promotes no new primitive, shared service, topology classifier, universal score or scheduler. External convergence strengthens semantic priors and proposes new measurement dimensions only.
